doc.title: Iola Brubeck interviewed by Monk Rowe, Wilton, CT, July 17, 2011

title: Religious faith in Dave's upbringing
summary: Dave's mother, a Bible reader and choir director, gave him his religious background more than Iola's.

story.theme_name: Church, faith and religion in a musician's life
story.community_name: Church, faith and jazz: the sacred and the secular

blocks.x: Well your faith, your religious faith, has come out in a lot of music in the last number of years. And I wondered if that was part of your upbringing, or did you and Dave sort of grow into that together?

More in his upbringing than mine. His mother was very much a Bible reader, but more than that, more of a seeker and a searcher. And so he grew up with that background. And his mother was a choir director and as a little kid he went to church that was next door to where he lived in Concord, and on Wednesday nights or whenever the choir practiced he sat there and listened to choir practice. So that was more a part of his life than mine.
